title: 周末家庭晚餐
titlePinyin: zhōu mò jiā tíng wǎn cān

explanations.2: Indicates the action is done together with family.
explanations.4: Indicates the location of the restaurant.
explanations.5: Indicates the position of the supermarket relative to the restaurant.
explanations.7: Indicates the order of actions, ordering tea first.
explanations.8: Quantifies the number of cups of tea.
explanations.9: Measure word for cups of tea.
explanations.10: Measure word for a portion of noodles.
explanations.11: Indicates the sister is still young.
explanations.13: Verb indicating the action of using chopsticks.
explanations.14: Indicates the location outside the restaurant.
explanations.15: Intensifier expressing how happy the weekend is.

translation: On Saturday, my family and I went to eat together. We went to a Chinese restaurant. The restaurant is inside the mall, and there is a supermarket on the left. We first ordered two cups of tea. Then my mother ordered a portion of noodles. Dad likes to eat rice, so he ordered a bowl. My younger sister is still young, she cannot use chopsticks. So we helped her with spoons. After eating, we went for a walk together. Outside it was very cool, we walked for half an hour. After returning home, I immediately did my homework. This weekend is really happy.
